name: khusi-kirana
description: MERN Stack Grocery Platform - Khusi Kirana

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
